title: DkimSigner construction duplicated verbatim in smtp/main.rs and reader/server_stores.rs
description: The ~20 lines that decode key_seed_b64, decode public_key_b64, call Ed25519Key::from_seed_and_public_key, zeroize seed, call DkimSigner::from_key().domain().selector().headers(), and return Arc::new(signer) are copy-pasted identically in smtp/src/main.rs (lines 199-231) and reader/src/store/server_stores.rs (lines 386-418). A free function build_dkim_signer(dcfg: &DkimConfig) -> Result<Arc<...>, String> in smtp/src/config.rs or a new smtp/src/dkim.rs would eliminate the duplication. The suggested rewrite: pub fn build_dkim_signer(dcfg: &DkimConfig) -> Result<Arc<DkimSignerArc>, String> { ... } called from both sites.
